csv_project_name: CMAR for University Stadium Renovation Phase 1
csv_agency: University of New Mexico Purchasing Department
csv_scope_of_work: The University of New Mexico (UNM or the University) will be accepting "Construction Manager at Risk Delivery Services (CMAR) qualification statements from licensed and experienced construction firms interested in providing CMAR services for the construction of the UNM Phase 1 University Stadium Project. The University of New Mexico (UNM) Facilities Design & Construction (FDC) and UNM Athletic Department are planning improvements to University Stadium to enhance spectator circulation, code compliance, operational efficiency, and the overall game-day experience (the Project ). The Project is located in UNM s South Campus. The Project will involve coordination with UNM stakeholders including but not limited to Athletics, Facilities Design & Construction, and Facility Services.
